explanation: Public-repository CI only: the exporter overlay now splits the public Application workflow into lint/typecheck, unit-test and build/verify:release/browser-smoke jobs and adds a Security workflow (CodeQL, dependency review) with a CodeQL config ignoring vendor/. The results smoke spec waits up to 30 s for the first study bundle, which the public CI fetches from R2. No application code, registry entry, data product, evidence record, QC policy or private CI workflow changes.
